tools.name: get_started_building
tools.description: Get the canonical ways to start building on Zapier as a developer: connecting Zapier MCP, installing the Zapier SDK, and using the Zapier SDK CLI. Returns install commands, starter prompts, and documentation links for each path. Use this when a user wants to build with or develop on Zapier programmatically.

tools.name: list_app_categories
tools.description: List the Zapier app categories featured in the site footer (e.g. CRM, Email, Project management). Returns each category's name, slug, and the canonical URL of its category page. Use this to browse apps by category.

tools.name: list_app_guides
tools.description: List the editorial guides and comparisons featured in the site footer (e.g. "Best CRM Apps", "Workato vs. Zapier"). Returns each piece's title and canonical URL. Use this to find Zapier's recommendations for the best apps for a common job.

tools.name: list_popular_apps
tools.description: List the popular Zapier app integrations featured in the site footer. Returns each app's name, slug, and the canonical URL of its Zapier integrations page.

tools.name: list_top_searched_apps
tools.description: List the most-searched Zapier app integrations featured in the site footer. Returns each app's name, slug, and the canonical URL of its Zapier integrations page.

tools.name: list_trending_apps
tools.description: List the currently trending Zapier app integrations featured in the site footer. Returns each app's name, slug, and the canonical URL of its Zapier integrations page.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the Zapier app directory by keyword. Returns matching apps with name, slug, URL, and description.

query.description: Keywords to search the Zapier app directory — an app name or category (e.g. "Slack", "CRM").

limit.description: Maximum number of apps to return (1–20, default 5).
